meaning:
χρῄζω
(χρή) [in LXX Jdg.11:7, 1Ki.17:18 A * ;]
to need, have need of: with genitive of thing(s), Mat.6:32, Luk.11:8 12:30, 2Co.3:1; with genitive of person(s) before ἐν, Rom.16:2.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he…
that you receive her in the Lord, in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has…
Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?
